verdicts.rationale: The divergence hint is gcsim-internal / frame-sourcing process-talk, not a user-facing timeline divergence. gcsim's restriction of Kaveh's plunge to the AirborneXianyun state is a gcsim modeling detail; the planner itself authors plungeFrames and renders a plunge whenever a plunge token is typed, and in-game every character (Kaveh included) can perform a standard plunging attack. So the timeline matches in-game reality — no decision-relevant omission or misrepresentation to repair. The remaining content (highPlunge-vs-lowPlunge frame choice, 'reviewer to verify plunge availability') is frame-data and curator-verification talk that belongs in _curatorNotes, not a user-facing caveat.

groundedIn.claim: The divergence hint is a gcsim-modeling detail flagged for reviewer verification, not an established user-facing divergence.
groundedIn.quote: plungeFrames: LowPlungeAttack and HighPlungeAttack in gcsim only accept AirborneXianyun state — standard plunge not modeled. Reviewer to verify in-game plunge availability independently of Xianyun.

groundedIn.claim: The ability describes a standard plunging attack, which the planner renders via authored plungeFrames — so there is no divergence from in-game reality.
groundedIn.quote:
Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
